regulatory_history.title: Rushing v. The Walt Disney Company (N.D. Cal. No. 3:17-cv-04419-JD): class settlement with Unity Technologies SF approved
regulatory_history.body: US District Court for the Northern District of California
regulatory_history.notes: Final approval with no finding of wrongdoing. Unity's injunctive terms, which ran three years from the settlement's effective date: keep a COPPA flag; offer a contextual-ads-only setting, switched on for Designed for Families and Kids Category apps; delete advertising IDs it held from listed children's apps; let users opt out of interest-based ads.
